modern: A man has seldom been seen to be unhappy through not observing what is in another’s mind; but those who do not observe the movements of their own minds must necessarily be unhappy.
original: Through not observing what is in the mind of another a man has seldom been seen to be unhappy; but those who do not observe the movements of their own minds must of necessity be unhappy.
notification: A man has seldom been seen to be unhappy through not observing what is in another’s mind; but those who do not observe the movements of their own minds must necessarily be unhappy.
notification_original: Through not observing what is in the mind of another a man has seldom been seen to be unhappy…

explained.summary: People rarely end up miserable because they failed to work out what someone else was thinking. They do end up miserable when they don’t pay attention to what’s going on in their own minds. Other people’s thoughts are out of your hands; your own are the one thing you can actually examine and change.
explained.today: Hours spent decoding a short text from a friend or guessing what a colleague meant by a comment would be better spent noticing your own mood, assumptions and reactions.
